headline: Castrol India reports 49% drop in Q3 profit due to rising input costs
hook: Raw material costs bite into Castrol's margins
summary: Castrol India announced its financial results for the third quarter, reporting a significant 49% drop in net profit. The decline was primarily driven by increasing raw material costs that squeezed operating margins. For Indian retail investors holding the stock, the sharp profit contraction signals margin pressures within the lubricants sector. This earnings miss highlights how input cost inflation continues to impact profitability for established manufacturing firms.
whats_next: Management commentary on input cost outlook in upcoming investor call
why_it_matters: Margin pressures weigh on Castrol India shareholder returns.
winners_losers: Raw material suppliers gain / Castrol India hurt
